regression.def: Fitting a model of a chosen type (linear, quadratic, cubic, quartic, and later exponential and others) to all the data at once with a calculator, which picks the constants that make the model closest to the data. Linear regression and quadratic regression are the common cases.

inverse-variation.def: Inverse proportion: y = k/x, so the product xy stays constant and doubling x halves y. An inverse-square law, y = k/x^2, divides y by 4 when x doubles, as for light intensity and distance.
